chunks: We have sent down to you the Book with the truth so that you may judge between people by what Allah has shown you, and do not be a contender for the deceitful.

key_terms.بِمَا أَرَاكَ اللَّهُ: By what Allah has shown you

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'li-tahkuma bayna an-nas' in Surah An-Nisa?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is pivotal for establishing the Prophet's authority to judge based on divine revelation (Wahi), often linked to the concept of 'Ismah' (infallibility) ensuring his judgments are free from error. It underscores the transition from tribal arbitration to divinely guided jurisprudence, emphasizing that the Prophet acts as the ultimate arbiter in disputes among the community.
